corrections.reason: The final character has the 2nd-order (ካዕብ) right-side stroke of ዙ, forming ግዕዙን ('its Ge'ez text/reading') with ን on the next line.
The image shows 6th-order ስ in መንፈስ (citing the nominative Ge'ez lemma 'እስመ መንፈስ') and 6th-order እ in the Amharic gerundive phrase እያልክ መልስ ('go back saying...').
The final glyph is 6th-order ህ (ከወዲህ), matching the parallel phrases on lines 31-32.
Both visually (shortened left leg of 4th-order ባ) and grammatically in the classic Andemta Christological formula 'ባጭር ቁመት በጠባብ ደረት ተወስኖ' (beka + አጭር -> ባጭር), the printed character is ባ.
